name: layer
description: Stacks its children in one box, later ones on top, with the box as tall as the tallest of them.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of every child in the box. baseline behaves as start here.

children.description: A child that places itself vertically: start, center, end, stretch, or baseline.
A child that places itself horizontally: start, center, end, or stretch.

markers.name: data-align-self
markers.description: Where the child sits vertically: start, center, end, stretch, or baseline.

markers.name: data-justify-self
markers.description: Where the child sits horizontally: start, center, end, or stretch.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-scrim
tokens.description: Wash behind a figure's caption, so it reads over the picture.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: A figure caption over the picture, which is not the aside a caption under one is.

a11y.notes: Everything stays in reading order. Text laid over a picture needs a contrast treatment (a scrim or a solid panel); the layer does not add one.
